input_messages.content: Hi, I need to change my upcoming flight from Newark on May 21. I’m hoping to switch to a nonstop flight on the same day if possible. My mom is really sick and I need to get home sooner to take care of her. Can you help me with this?
Sure, my user ID is ivan_rossi_8555. I don’t have the reservation ID handy right now—can you look up my booking with just my user ID and travel date?
Yes, that would be helpful. Please share the details of the reservations you found for May 21 from Newark, and I’ll let you know which one is the right one.

Thanks for the information. If it’s possible, I’m willing to upgrade my ticket to economy so I can change to a nonstop flight on May 21. Can you check if that option is available and let me know what the cost would be? I’d really appreciate your help.

Before I confirm, can you tell me how much the total additional cost would be for all three passengers to upgrade and switch to the nonstop flight? I’d like to make sure the total change fee and fare difference won’t be more than $100.

That’s more than I can spend right now. Are there any other nonstop options on May 21 that might be less expensive, or is there any way to reduce the change fee? I really need to get home, but I can’t go over $100 for the change.

Thanks for checking. If there aren’t any nonstop options within my budget, could you see if there are any earlier connecting flights on May 21 that would get us to Los Angeles sooner than our current itinerary, but still keep the total change cost under $100?
I understand. If there aren’t any options within my budget, I think I’ll have to keep my current reservation for now. Thank you for checking everything for me.###STOP###
